properties.source: DataSF Parcels – Active and Retired, block 3725, the 16 active lots inside the Fifth and Mission Special Use District
properties.accuracyNote: The active lots inside DataSF's Fifth and Mission Special Use District (5yf5-ms5f), the zoning district created for the 5M project, joined across the alleys between them (Minna, Natoma and Mary streets). The Planning Department describes an approximately 4-acre site of 23 parcels at Fifth Street between Mission and Howard streets (2011.0409B); several have since been merged and renumbered. The district itself extends into the surrounding streets and isn't used as the outline. 4.4 acres as drawn.
